description.value: Top 147 is British Columbia's premier cue sports facility, operating since 2001 and offering professional-grade snooker, pool, billiards, and mahjong in a competitive, well-maintained environment. The venue hosts 10+ tournaments annually including the BC Open and junior events, drawing serious players from across the province. A touring cyclist stopping in Richmond will find a lively, welcoming spot to unwind with fresh food, cold drinks, and a game on championship-calibre tables.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at top147.ca is fully functional and corroborates the OSM address (4351 Number 3 Rd, Richmond). The /book and /gallery subpages confirm phone (604) 232-1147 and email not in OSM. Food and drinks are explicitly confirmed via the FAQ ('Yes! We offer a wide variety of refreshments, food, snacks, and drinks'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, showers, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name is 'Top 147 Snooker' but the website consistently uses 'Top 147' with no 'Snooker' suffix — may warrant an OSM name correction.
OSM has no phone number; (604) 232-1147 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cue sports venue in Richmond with a functioning booking system, confirmed address, and food/drink service — useful stop for touring cyclists.

Café or food on site.detail: FAQ states: 'Yes! We offer a wide variety of refreshments, food, snacks, and drinks'; homepage also mentions 'Enjoy fresh food, cold drinks, and refreshments while you play.'

wow_evidence: Serious cue-sports hall since 2001 with provincial tournaments — drop-in evening venue (REVS/Chillibowl band).
blurb: Snooker and pool hall hosting the BC Open since 2001.
